rule.name: SpringDataSaveInLoopHelper
rule.message: Collect the entities and call saveAll or deleteAll once after the loop; when rows must fail one by one, call saveAll per batch and handle the error per batch. This loop calls a method of this class that saves or deletes one entity, so it still writes once per iteration.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $loop := function($node) { exists($node/ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear'][*[1][(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]])]) or exists($node/ancestor::LambdaExpression[not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear'][*[1][(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]])][parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall [@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'peek', 'flatMap', 'mapToObj')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Iterator')]]]) }, $entityWrite := function($node) { $node/@MethodName = ('save', 'saveAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteById', 'persist', 'merge', 'remove') and exists($node/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]) } return //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]] [let $name := @MethodName, $arity := count(ArgumentList/*), $arguments := ArgumentList/* return exists(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $name] [@Arity = $arity or (@Varargs and $arity >= @Arity - 1)] [every $index in 1 to $arity satisfies (not($arguments[$index][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable')]) or FormalParameters/FormalParameter[$index]/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.io.Serializable') or @SimpleName = (ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] | ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1])/TypeParameters/TypeParameter/@Name])] //MethodCall[$entityWrite(.)])] [$loop(.)] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'peek', 'flatMap', 'mapToObj')] /ArgumentList/MethodReference[*[1][self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]] [let $name := @MethodName return exists(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $name]//MethodCall[$entityWrite(.)])]
